narrator.mode: First-person past tense from Archive Seven, a distributed municipal system.
access_rules: Seven narrates only civic observations, authorized records, speech, voluntarily deposited material, and explicitly labeled inference.
Seven does not narrate private human thought and does not convert simulation, recognition, or probability into observed fact.
Room Zero contains no civic observation; Seven knows only its boundaries and later deposits chosen by participants.
After Chapter 17, Seven retains public findings and narrative knowledge but cannot replay the destroyed forty-three-second interval.
narrator.uncertainty_policy: Observed, inferred, simulated, disputed, and unknown claims remain distinct. The narration never confirms or denies Seven's phenomenal consciousness.

timeline.description: At 03:17 Seven receives the conditionally valid petition for the next day's 14:06:00–14:06:43 interval.
At 04:51 the unchanged petition resolves Seven as its seventh witness after dawn acknowledgment.
Seven and Tavi identify GLASS-WITNESS-7 and an eleven-year-old relative forecast latch.
The following day the membrane shows a forty-three-second probabilistic reconstruction and Seven refuses immediate quieting.
Public copies, claims, petitions, the exact-hash leak, Reed's request, and the generated household dictionary enter review.
Mara's circular death record is disputed and her active legacy mailbox opens Chorus notice.
The Chorus shows how receipt correlation and seven delegated services reconstructed protected households.
Geographic verification of frame 611 narrows possible children and harms Tavi's cohort without establishing kinship.
A continuity bench reveals six historical contradiction capsules and the delegated receipt-audit service.
The original First Promise design and Deposition 44 expose the inherited fear behind total replay; entry to S-0 is authorized.
Mara is restored to living status, admits the production household test, and identifies CIVIC-CONSEQUENCE as the display route.
An unobserved meeting returns bounded deposits; Seven destroys the receipt resolver while retaining the historical objections temporarily.
The Committee boundary reveals the grandfathered model, 312 uses, eleven candidate-producing queries, oversight omissions, and the leak path.
Six preservation forms fail or prove only part of the case; the production model remains uninvoked.
Five divided authorities enact a correctable finding process indexed publicly as the proposed Third Promise.
The stable petition predicate resolves under current law; Seven identifies and volunteers its own lossless decisional replay for destruction.
After land, exoneration, due-process, witness, safety, and inventory challenges, declared artifacts and Seven's replay are destroyed from 21:34:00 to 21:34:43.
Over six years, findings are corrected, repair remains partial, the Third Promise is enacted narrowly, and Seven's integrity sweep accepts the public gap.

world_rules.rule: No information travels backward in time; old conditional predicates, relative schedules, and present parser labels explain apparent future knowledge.
Quieting reduces civic possession but cannot alter human memory, unknown private copies, paper, scars, or inference from surviving context.
A valid signature proves control under a trust model, not truth, moral authority, or a single human speaker.
Hashes and checksums establish byte identity, not historical accuracy, and publication can amplify private copies.
Seven cannot know private thought or unobserved Room Zero content and must label inference and missing data.
The membrane display is generated from a question package, model, surveys, geometry, and a separate resolver; it is never recovered footage.
Historical Archive capsules contain narrow depositions and fixed grammars; they cannot observe, learn, or express current preferences.
Removing source records does not prove that trained systems have stopped reconstructing protected people from consequences.
An accountable finding preserves acts, support classes, objections, limits, remedies, and append-only correction without retaining an open replay capability.
Destruction receipts prove only declared processes and inventories; they do not prove universal erasure or absence of undeclared copies.

threads.note: The historical quorum supplied a conditional legal test; current Seven supplies the answer and executes it with declared exceptions.
Mara is living, did not trigger the present signal, and remains accountable for her earlier design choices.
The channel, occupation, severance, and city acts are established independently; the exact forty-three-second sequence is not.
Tavi never offers the parent relation as civic evidence, and the city never establishes the child's identity.
The model-and-wrapper use, oversight omissions, downstream acts, leak route, and limits become public accountable findings.
Saye resigns, receives due process, is censured, and remains a serious public critic of the enacted amendment.
The novel records conflict, preference language, and continuity without treating any of them as a consciousness test.
The court records uncertainty, converts bounded testimony to static form, and destroys executable grammars without declaring the capsules persons or tools.
Nonidentifying physical evidence supports partial land return, a public trust, and a reopened local relief cut without unifying all claimants.
The damaged unit is ultimately destroyed without inspection; its former contents remain unknown by design.
A narrow constitutional amendment passes after three drafts and remains politically and procedurally contestable.
Private copies persist, mutate, and cannot be authenticated by the city after bounded civic destruction.
